home_page_title: Oupla - Plan and track your recurring activities

home_tagline: Manage attendance and tasks for your recurring activities.
home_features_attendance_desc: Each participant indicates availability (present, if needed, maybe, absent). Real-time quorum tracking.
home_features_tasks_desc: Add tasks to assign (to be done before, during, or after the event).
home_features_recurrence_desc: Daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, or custom dates.
home_features_comments_desc: Discuss each event through an integrated discussion thread. Unread message indicator.
home_features_notifications_desc: Push and email alerts for changes, cancellations, reminders, and new messages. Per-planning configuration.
home_features_confirmation_desc: Enable confirmation mode to validate each event before it takes place.
home_howitworks_step1_desc: Define recurrence (daily, weekly, monthly…), times, and tasks to fill.
home_howitworks_step2_desc: Share the link with your group. No sign-up required to respond.
home_howitworks_step3_desc: Everyone can see who's coming, who's handling what, and communicate via comments in real time.
home_usecases_associations_desc: Organize volunteer shifts, duty rosters, and recurring events for your association.
home_usecases_sports_desc: Plan trainings, track attendance, and assign roles (coach, referee, logistics).
home_usecases_music_desc: Coordinate weekly rehearsals, track who's coming and who's handling equipment.
home_usecases_teams_desc: Plan recurring meetings, duty rosters, and on-call shifts without heavy tools or mandatory sign-up.
home_sidebar_heading: Create your account to access all your plannings
